intent: Hold a control placed before the header's text, such as a back link or a view switch.
typical_uses: A back link to the list the page was opened from
A toggle group switching a list between its table and gallery views

dont_use_when.situation: An action on the page's content, such as creating or uploading

invariants.text: PageHeaderLeading is a flex row that centers its children vertically, spaces them var(--space-2) apart and does not shrink; the root's gap puts var(--space-4) between it and the text block.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the page's primary action before the title
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put it in PageHeaderActions, at the end of the header

good.title: A back link before a project's title
good.code:
<PageHeaderLeading>
  <Button
    variant="ghost"
    icon={<ArrowLeftIcon />}
    aria-label="Back to projects"
    render={<a href="/projects" />}
    nativeButton={false}
  />
</PageHeaderLeading>

bad.title: The primary action placed before the title
bad.why: The leading slot is for a control that orients the page, read before its title; the page's actions belong at the end, in PageHeaderActions, which also takes a line of its own when the header is narrow.
